Takeda PQC Received the folLOWing report via email from Medical Information: A patient called in requesting medical information regarding Adderall XR and subsequently reported AE/PQC. The patient stated, "Adderall XR 20 MG capsules, what are the coloring of the beads? They used to be white and orange, and now they are more all orange? I just took one of the capsules, and I feel like it's garbage. I can't do anything with this. It's like it has a negative effect on me now. The beads are white and orange. This one says manufacturer Shire-US. The pill outside says Adderall XR 20 mg. I opened it up and the beads are white and orange. This prescription is brand, not generic. This cost a lot of money, my insurance doesn't cover the brand and it was 400 dollars for the prescription. I am pretty sure there has been a change. I have gone to my doctor and there is nothing else that it can be. Is there anything that could have changed to have me feeling like this and not the way I always did? I have been on the medication for a long time. I was just almost an hour on the phone with these other two ladies reporting all of this information in detail. I have been taking this (Adderall XR) for 5 years and every morning I do the same thing; I wake up, I take it with a glass of water, and then 20-30 minutes later I start to get ready, I get lunch for the girls, and breakfast. Now it's like I can barely get out of bed, I am confused, I don't know if I am coming or going, I don't know what I am doing. It's like the computer in my brain has no idea what to do. This started with the prescription on 28Jun2020 of this year. The Adderall XR worked perfectly for so many years, and now it's like I am taking poison. It's like I am taking a sad pill or like I am taking Nyquil. How would you know it's an extended release? Something changed in that batch, or whatever CVS is giving out. My body and brain knows there is something different. Wen I wake up in the morning I feel better than when I take the pills, and before that it wasn't like that. I had to go to generic and I made the change, and the same thing happened. Whenever there is a change this is how I feel. If I taking the same thing and then I feel like this, then something changed. I switched insurance and was put on the generic, and not the brand before. I had to pay out of pock for the brand, which was then working fine again just like before, but then this time, this prescription that I have in my hand did the same thing to me. (patient clarified that their current prescription is brand, and not a generic). CVS doesn't carry these generics anymore. CVS gave me a different generic other than Prasco, Sandoz, Amerigen; one that was Bagino (patient unsure of spelling) or something? My body and brain knows there is something different. When I wake up in the morning I feel better than when I take the pills, and before that it wasn't like that. I wish I could get a refund, these pills are terrible and so expensive." 1. Unit: 20 MG 2. treatment), I noticed that batch 8894229 is not really working. I thought the problem was with me,
because, in addition to not feeling any effect, drowsiness is what I feel most when I take the medicine, but, from the comments,

to my surprise, I found that, before, the pills came with ingredients to the top and released in the capsule and,
now, they come compressed and in half. It is up to the laboratory to check if it is this circumstance that is changing the
effects of the medication and, if the problem is not solved, I will complain to the competent authorities (because

any information on the forecast for replenishment of the national market. This is a lack of responsibility, yet

receive feedback from the laboratory about the product in a week, I will enter the special civil court to demand, in
early guardianship, the obligation to deliver the drug! I will not be waiting for your good will to
make the medicine available while suffering the consequences of abrupt discontinuation of the medicine.
And there is no point in advising you to take another medicine because, in that crappy country, THERE IS NO MEDICINE
WITH SIMILAR ACTIVE PRINCIPLES!
This is extremely serious and, for those who are suffering the same problem, I notice that there are two petitions
circulating online (one asking for the reduction of the abusive value and the other asking for the patent to be broken due to the lack of
medicine).

accountable. But as this is Brazil, the situation has to be taken to the extreme to learn to respect the
patients, especially psychiatric ones.

Patient contacted us informing us that he has been using Venvanse since October 2021, and that he previously used the drug at a dose of 50mg from Shire, but the doctor increased the dose to 70mg in January, as the patient no longer found a 50mg product with the logo Shire.
The patient used 3 bottles of 70mg Venvanse and reports a very large difference in the reduction of effects.
The patient points out that he has one more recipe for Venvanse, but that he does not feel confident using the Takeda product, and mentioned complaints that he saw on Reclame Aqui.
Consumer informs that the lot that is currently being used has compressed powder. Because of this, yesterday the consumer diluted the product in water to administer it and today he chewed the powder.
Consumer was ingesting the entire product.
Patient uses Bupium for concentration. The doctor prescribed Bupium to decrease the effect of Venvanse, since the use of Venvanse and Bupium leads to a synergy and increases serotonin levels.
The patient reports that he has been using Bupium for 1 month, but there has been no increase in the desired effect of Venvanse. However, the patient points out that he felt the effect of Bupium when he woke up feeling more energetic.

Was the product handled in a compounding pharmacy? Not.
When was the product purchased? NI
When was it opened? NI

Consumer reported three pharmacovigilance scenarios regarding other patients:
Initially, the consumer reported that the doctor reported that she received reports of a decrease in the effect of the product.
The patient verified with a friend who uses Venvanse, that in addition to feeling the decrease in effect and presence of compacted powder, he also uses the product sublingually, in an attempt to achieve the desired therapeutic effects.
The patient reported that while using this bottle, he gave a capsule to a friend to test, and that friend did not feel the expected effects of the product, going so far as to compare it with a placebo. The friend informs that the potency of Shire's medicine was better.
No information about other consumers was provided.
I informed according to the manual that the product, that the presence of compacted powder can occur during the manufacturing process and has no relation to the effectiveness of the product, and that after the acquisition of Shire by Takeda, there were no changes in the manufacturing process or suppliers of product. I informed that we received product complaints as the consumer verified on the Reclame Aqui website, but that so far, when collection and analysis is appropriate, no batch with quality deviation has been identified.
I advised that regarding the treatment, the doctor should be consulted to assess whether the use of Venvanse continues to be beneficial to the patient, or if any adjustment is necessary.
